name: global-interface-augmentation-read-by-a-test
description: An ambient interface of the global scope that merges into one the compiler's library declarations declare, ImportMeta here, types the value the runtime provides, so a test file's read of a member it declares uses it as production code does and it is not reported. An ambient global interface that merges into no outside declaration is judged by who uses it: a test's use alone leaves it production code only tests use, reported at possible.
